correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md blob 67b12fc260f3d5e31539f28df1f8a6b2d91b6bcc and verify.py blob 19630e47eac9623dd1f5677c4e2823a511664946. Explicit dyadic low/high attracting sets cover zero-only words via longest gap, one-1 factors via dominating neighboring gaps, and multi-1 factors via alternating consecutive-1 pairs. The trailing-zero projection lemma maps any suffix-block attractor to one for W_m. Lower-bound certificates comprise factors U_i=10^{2^i-1}1 with unique occurrences in disjoint intervals, additional unique V_m and F_m, and in even high blocks a zero-only factor restricted to the suffix. This matches each upper formula, including m=2 edge cases. Independent direct factor-mask coverage checked 76 values through n≈184 and seven larger dyadic thresholds, with brute optimality for n≤12. No extrapolation from bounded tests is used.
